items.text: delivery wala nahi mil raha
address samajh nahi aaya
please call kar lo
haan ji
order cancel kar do
kab aayega

items.context: Kya delivery wale se baat hui?
items.text: haan mile the

items.context: Kya address sahi diya hai aapne?
items.text: address confirm kar lo

items.context: To delivery banda aap se contact kar paaya?
items.text: nahin mila abhi tak
delivery person phone nahi utha raha hai
wo aadmi location find nahi kar pa raha hai
maine address bar bar samjha diya
pata hume correct diya hai phir bhi problem hai
please aap unko call karke bata do
order time se delay ho raha hai abhi tak
kya aap phir se unhe contact kar sakte ho?

items.context: Kya delivery wala ne aapko koi wajah batayi?
items.text: delivery guy ne kaha road par traffic jyada hai
maine toh poora address message mein bhej diya hai

items.context: Kya aap delivery person ko call kar pa rahe hain?
items.text: main do baar phone kar raha hoon lekin call nahi utha rahe

items.context: Delivery person ne aap se kya kaha?
items.text: kya driver ne kaha kahin kho gaya hai delivery location?

items.context: Delivery person ne aapko kya bataya?
items.text: delivery boy ke paas address nahi samajh mein aa raha hai
delivery boy ne bar bar call kiya lekin mein baahar nahi tha toh miss ho gaya tha
maine address phir se check kiya hai yehi sahi hai lekin unko lagta hai koi confusion hai
aapke system mein mera address kya registered hai wo bata do please mujhe call karwa do
wo aadmi baar baar bola ki location dikh nahi rahi hai phone mein ye dikkat ho rahi hai
mai waiting hoon abhi tak delivery boy mujhe contact nahi kar pa raha hai phone pe
kripya karke agent ko bol kar mujhe confirm karwa do ke delivery boy mere aas paas hai ya nahi
kya aap log driver ko correct location bhej sakte ho main bahut pareshan ho raha hoon
maine already delivery boy ko 3 baar call kiya lekin wo phone nahi utha raha hai
wo delivery person kah raha hai ki road band hai jiske wajah se woh abhi delivery nahi kar pa raha
mera address Gurgaon hai lekin delivery guy pucha kaunsa sector hai lagta kuch confusion hai
delivery delay ho gaya hai kyunki driver ko location samajh nahi aa rahi main phone pe madad nahi kar pa raha
main chahata hoon ki aapka customer support jaldi se delivery boy se baat kare aur location clear kare
driver kah raha hai ki wo thoda door par hai aur road nahi mil raha isliye osne call kiya tha

items.context: Kya aapne delivery boy ki taraf se call miss kiya hai?
items.text: maine aapko pehle bhi bataya tha ki delivery boy baar baar call kar raha hai lekin mein busy tha

items.context: Delivery person ne aapko kya problem batayi thi?
items.text: delivery boy ne kaha ki location thoda confusing hai usne mujhe call par route samjhane ko kaha tha

items.context: Hum driver se contact karna chahte hain aap batayein kya karein?
items.text: aap turant driver ko contact kar ke unko exact address wapas bhejdijiye mujhe order chahiye jaldi

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: agent_unreachable - the delivery person is not answering or cannot find the address
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
